nodes.label: Redirect to CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md exists as a discovery shim so tools that look for AGENTS.md still land on the canonical instructions in CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Compliance Oracle
nodes.rationale: A single fixed stdout line provides a byte-exact pass/fail oracle that stays identical across compliant Node.js runtimes.

nodes.label: Meta-Rule of Safety
nodes.rationale: When no rule directly applies, the process defaults to safety so determinism, scope control, and governance immutability are not weakened by ambiguity.

nodes.label: False-Pass Test Suite Warning
nodes.rationale: The README explicitly warns that a silent exit 0 from npm test is not a real pass when the test file is absent, preventing superficial validation claims.

nodes.label: Runtime Oracle
nodes.rationale: The runtime is intentionally reduced to a deterministic oracle whose behavior can be byte-verified.

nodes.label: Governance Constitution
nodes.rationale: The four governance markdown files collectively constrain how agents may change the runtime layer while having no runtime effect themselves.

nodes.label: Conflict Resolution Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: The document defines a total order for disagreements: MISSION.md for scope, GUARDRAILS.md for process, and CLAUDE.md for style and conventions.

nodes.label: Governance Files Immutable to Automation
nodes.rationale: Automation must never edit the core governance documents; any such change is defined as a compliance failure and must be escalated to a human.

nodes.label: On-Demand Context Modules
nodes.rationale: Deeper topic-specific guidance is split into separate context modules that should be loaded only when a task touches that topic.
